items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: A fellow by the name of T. B. Jones had charge of the band.

ctx.x: Well, when you went to college, did you continue to study music?
yeah, I continued to study. I was in the band there, in the band there in Biddle. A fellow by the name of T. B. Jones had charge of the band. Yes.
And was this a concert band or a marching band, or --
